text_en: As he walked along, he saw a man blind from birth.
text_cn: 耶稣前行时，看见了一个生来瞎眼的人。

text_en: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind? ”
text_cn: 他的门徒就问他说：“辣彼，谁犯了罪？是他，还是他的父母，竟使他生来瞎眼呢？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned; he was born blind so that God’s works might be revealed in him.
text_cn: 耶稣答复说：“也不是他犯了罪，也不是他的父母，而是为叫天主的工作，在他身上显扬出来。

text_en: We must work the works of him who sent me while it is day; night is coming when no one can work.
text_cn: 趁着白天，我们应做派遣我来者的工作；黑夜来到，就没有人能工作了。

text_en: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world. ”
text_cn: 当我在世界上的时候，我是世界的光。”

text_en: When he had said this, he spat on the ground and made mud with the saliva and spread the mud on the man’s eyes,
text_cn: 耶稣说了这话以后，便吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和了些泥，把泥抹在瞎子的眼上，

text_en: saying to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means Sent). Then he went and washed and came back able to see.
text_cn: 对他说：“去，到史罗亚水池里洗洗罢！”──史罗亚解说“被派遣的”──瞎子去了，洗了，回来就看见了。

text_en: The neighbors and those who had seen him before as a beggar began to ask, “Is this not the man who used to sit and beg? ”
text_cn: 于是，邻居和那些素来曾见他讨饭的人，就说：“这不是那曾坐着讨饭的人么？”

text_en: Some were saying, “It is he. ” Others were saying, “No, but it is someone like him. ” He kept saying, “I am the man. ”
text_cn: 有的说：“就是这人，”有的说：“不，是另一个很相似他的人。”那人却说：“就是我。”

text_en: But they kept asking him, “Then how were your eyes opened? ”
text_cn: 他们问他说：“你的眼睛究竟是怎样开的呢？”

text_en: He answered, “The man called Jesus made mud, spread it on my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to Siloam and wash. ’ Then I went and washed and received my sight. ”
text_cn: 他答复说：“名叫耶稣的那个人，和了些泥，抹在我的眼上，给我说：你往史罗亚去洗洗罢；我去了，洗了，就看见了。”

text_en: They said to him, “Where is he? ” He said, “I do not know. ”
text_cn: 他们又问他说：“那个人在哪里？”他说：“我不知道。”

text_en: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had formerly been blind.
text_cn: 他们便将先前瞎眼的人，领到法利塞人那里。

text_en: Now it was a sabbath day when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
text_cn: 耶稣和泥开他眼睛的那天，正是安息日。

text_en: Then the Pharisees also began to ask him how he had received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes. Then I washed, and now I see. ”
text_cn: 于是，法利塞人又诘问他怎样看见了。那人就向他们说：“他把泥放在我的眼上，我洗了，就看见了。”

text_en: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for he does not observe the sabbath. ” But others said, “How can a man who is a sinner perform such signs? ” And they were divided.
text_cn: 法利塞人中有的说：“这人不是从天主来的，因为他不遵守安息日。”有的却说：“一个罪人怎能行这样的奇迹？”他们中间便发生了纷争。

text_en: So they said again to the blind man, “What do you say about him? It was your eyes he opened. ” He said, “He is a prophet. ”
text_cn: 于是，他们又问瞎子说：“对于那开了你眼睛的人，你说什么呢？”瞎子说：“他是一位先知。”

text_en: The Jews did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they called the parents of the man who had received his sight
text_cn: 可是，犹太人不肯相信他先是瞎子而后看见了，等到叫了复明者的父母来，

text_en: and asked them, “Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How then does he now see? ”
text_cn: 问他们说：“这是你们的儿子么？你们说他生来就瞎么？怎么他现在竟看见了呢？”

text_en: His parents answered, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
text_cn: 他的父母答复说：“我们知道这是我们的儿子，也生来就瞎。

text_en: but we do not know how it is that now he sees, nor do we know who opened his eyes. Ask him; he is of age. He will speak for himself. ”
text_cn: 如今他究竟怎么看见了，我们却不知道；或者谁开了他的眼睛，我们也不知道。你们问他罢！他已经成年，会说自己的事了。”

text_en: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that anyone who confessed Jesus to be the Messiah would be put out of the synagogue.
text_cn: 他的父母因为害怕犹太人，才这样说，因为犹太人早已议定：谁若承认耶稣是默西亚，就必被逐出会堂。

text_en: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age; ask him. ”
text_cn: 为此，他的父母说：他已经成年，你们问他罢！

text_en: So for the second time they called the man who had been blind, and they said to him, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner. ”
text_cn: 于是法利塞人再把那先前瞎眼的人叫过来，向他说：“归光荣于天主罢！我们知道这人是个罪人。”

text_en: He answered, “I do not know whether he is a sinner. One thing I do know, that though I was blind, now I see. ”
text_cn: 那人回答说：“他是不是罪人，我不知道；有一件事我知道：我曾是个瞎子，现在我却看见了。”

text_en: They said to him, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes? ”
text_cn: 他们又问他说：“他给你作了什么？怎样开了你的眼睛？”

text_en: He answered them, “I have told you already, and you would not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become his disciples? ”
text_cn: 他回答说：“我已经告诉了你们，你们不听；为什么又愿意听呢？莫非你们也愿意做他的门徒么？”

text_en: Then they reviled him, saying, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
text_cn: 他们辱骂他说：“你去做他的门徒好了！我们是梅瑟的门徒。

text_en: We know that God has spoken to Moses, but as for this man, we do not know where he comes from. ”
text_cn: 我们知道：天主曾给梅瑟说过话；至于这人，我们不知道他是从哪里来的。”

text_en: The man answered, “Here is an astonishing thing! You do not know where he comes from, and yet he opened my eyes.
text_cn: 那人回答说：“这真奇怪！你们不知道他是从哪里来的，他却开了我的眼睛。

text_en: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but he does listen to one who worships him and obeys his will.
text_cn: 我们都晓得天主不俯听罪人，只俯听那恭敬天主，并承行他旨意的人。

text_en: Never since the world began has it been heard that anyone opened the eyes of a person born blind.
text_cn: 自古以来从未听说：有人开了生来就是瞎子的眼睛。

text_en: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing. ”
text_cn: 这人若不是由天主来的，他什么也不能作。”

text_en: They answered him, “You were born entirely in sins, and are you trying to teach us? ” And they drove him out.
text_cn: 他们却向他说：“你整个生于罪恶中，竟来教训我们？”便把他赶出去了。

text_en: Jesus heard that they had driven him out, and when he found him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man? ”
text_cn: 耶稣听说他们把他赶出去了，后来遇见了他，就给他说：“你信人子么？”

text_en: He answered, “And who is he, sir? Tell me, so that I may believe in him. ”
text_cn: 那人便回答说：“主，是谁，好使我去信他呢？”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “You have seen him, and the one speaking with you is he. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“你已看见他了，和你讲话的就是！”

text_en: He said, “Lord, I believe. ” And he worshiped him.
text_cn: 他遂说道：“主，我信。”遂俯伏朝拜了耶稣。

text_en: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment so that those who do not see may see, and those who do see may become blind. ”
text_cn: 耶稣遂说：“我是为了判别，才到这世界上来，叫那些看不见的，看得见；叫那些看得见的，反而成为瞎子。”

text_en: Some of the Pharisees near him heard this and said to him, “Surely we are not blind, are we? ”
text_cn: 有些和他在一起的法利塞人，一听了这话，就说：“难道我们也是瞎子么？”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would not have sin. But now that you say, ‘We see, ’ your sin remains.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“你们如果是瞎子，就没有罪了；但你们如今说：我们看得见，你们的罪恶便存留下了。”
